bosses.skill_detail_cn: Meteor Strike (CD 6.0s): Call a meteor down on the nearest enemy, dealing 360 true damage to it and nearby enemies plus this unit's element effect.
Overload Counter: After taking 8 hits, discharge for 450 true damage to the attacker with a 25% chance to interrupt them.
Mirror Split: For every 25% of max HP lost, split off a mirror image with 30% of max HP and 40% ATK. Clones cannot cast skills.
Holy Purify (CD 8.0s): Cleanse all statuses from every ally, heal them for 12% max HP and grant a shield worth 10% max HP.
Rage Stacks: Each landed normal attack grants ATK +3% and AS +0.03, up to 20 stacks.
Blood Frenzy: Below 35% HP, permanently enrage — ATK +40%, AS +0.30, and 10% lifesteal.
Soul Devour: Each kill restores 15% max HP and permanently raises ATK by 10%.
Twin Revival: The twins enter together. When one dies it revives after 5.0s at 30% HP, up to 1 time(s); no revival happens once every twin is dead.
Apocalypse Charge (CD 10.0s): Gain a shield worth 10% max HP and charge for 2.0s, then hit all enemies for 250% ATK (ignores DEF). Breaking the shield before it lands interrupts the cast.

Eternal Night (CD 12.0s): Rain meteors across the field, dealing 800 true damage to every enemy (ignores DEF).

mercenaries.skill_detail_cn: Bubble Dream (CD 6.0s): Heal the lowest-HP ally for 160 HP; slow the nearest enemy by 30% and deal 140 true damage.
Shell Guard: Gain 50% damage reduction for 5.0s.
Balance Judgement: Deal +40% damage against targets with more current HP than this unit.
Gold Charge: Rush the nearest enemy, deal 240 true damage and stun for 1.2s.
Holy Song (CD 10.0s): Heal all allies for 15% max HP and cleanse all crowd-control debuffs.
Mirror Ambush (CD 10.0s): Summon a mirror clone with 30% HP and 40% ATK.
King's Aura: Every 2s, buff nearby allies — AS +25%, Crit +25%.
Arrow Rain (CD 6.0s): Strike the nearest 5 enemies, each taking 85% ATK damage.
Blood Rage: For every 10% max HP lost, gain AS +10% and Lifesteal +5% plus a small damage boost.
Steel Order (CD 8.0s): Buff the nearest 3 allies — DMG Reduce 20%, AS +30%, CC Duration -30% for 8.0s.
Time Warp (CD 8.0s): Briefly boost own dodge; slow all enemies by 35% for 5.0s.
Death Hunt: Prioritizes low-HP targets; kills restore 15% max HP. Normal attacks break 8 armor and reduce healing by 70% for 4.0s.
